local:spatial-design-bundle.source: Caller-retained spatial design and optional base scene; source templates are owned by src/spatial-scene/design-templates.ts
local:spatial-design-bundle.note: Local user-managed files in fresh workspace directories; no provider meter or automatic deletion. Completion receipt follows durable asset publication.

posthog:site-events.note: Schema v2 cookieless canonical-production-only: pageview, pageleave, web vitals, budgeted redacted exceptions, CTA, install copy, outbound links and 404; no persons or replay.

static:workflow-examples.note: Only declared first-party reviewed derivatives; content hashes, bounded reads, no directory publication or raw runtime receipts.

r2:slopcamera-api-artifacts.note: Generated artifact bytes at a/<id>/<name> plus t/<id>.json ticket records; expiry is the bucket lifecycle rule, nothing deletes eagerly.

r2:slopcamera-api-uploads.note: Caller-owned inbound objects at u/<uuid> written through 15-minute presigned PUTs; consumed once into an ephemeral workspace.

provider:vercel-ai-gateway:image-generat.note: Paid slopcamera.image.generate calls; the cited worst-case price in src/generation-pricing.ts sets the hold ceiling before the provider call, and the returned token usage sets the settled cost. src/generate.ts owns the provider contract.

provider:credits:hold-settle.note: One hold plus exactly one settle or release per paid call; holds are idempotent on the caller idempotency key.

worker:slopcamera-objects.note: Signed request proxy over the private slopcamera-api-artifacts bucket; stores nothing itself, verifies HMAC(method,key,exp,maxBytes) and enforces the declared cap. Signatures minted by apps/api/src/object-proxy.ts.

local:drawing-sheets.source: Caller-retained drawing manifest with embedded version-one diagrams
local:drawing-sheets.note: Local replaceable vector PDF and SVG outputs with a source-and-output hash receipt; caller-managed retention, no provider calls or metering.

local:cli-update-preference.notes: Per-product update preference and installation identity; cli-update owns private state validation and preference changes.

local:cli-update-coordination.notes: Process leases and interrupted-install recovery records; uncertain installs remain blocked until verified recovery.

local:cli-update-archives.notes: Private verified archives beside the global installation. Package managers may reference them; retain each archive while referenced, never remove it as a disposable cache.
